title: THE ANVIL · DOUBLE-BELL PYRAMID
why: Power and strength, new shape: a four-lift chain with both 45s, climbing 1 to 5 and back down, no rest inside a rung. No treadmill after yesterday's 3-mile.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · shoulders / spine

items.name: Double clean 2×45 lb ×3 + front squat ×3 + push press ×3

blocks.title: THE PYRAMID · 1-2-3-4-5-4-3-2-1 · FOR TIME
blocks.meta: 9 RUNGS · 2×45 lb · cap 24:00 · bells never touch the floor inside a rung
blocks.format: Each rung is a chain: cleans, then front squats, then push presses, then renegade rows per side, all at the rung number, unbroken. Finish the rung with a 15-second double rack hold. Set the bells down, rest 60 to 90 s, next rung. 25 reps of each lift by the end. Record the finish time.
blocks.workRest: Rest 60 s on rungs 1-3 and 7-9, 90 s on rungs 4-6.

items.name: Renegade row 2×45 lb × rung per side

blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 9 rungs under 24:00 with one broken rung.

blocks.title: LOADED WALK · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 60 lb / 2×45 lb · 40 yd legs · walk back empty = rest

items.name: Copenhagen hold off the bench 20 s/side
Lat stretch on the bell 30 s/side
